name: Archivist
summary: He writes the names and makes them count: an anthem on a body for two Flux.

face.name: Archivist

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Your other Human Entities get +1 Power. The Archivist doesn't count itself, and the bonus lasts as long as it stays on the field.

face.flavor: He writes the names of those who went on.
